name: methods
value: Baseline characteristics were compared between groups defined by Treatment group. Data are presented as meanSD, geometric meanGSD, or median (Q1Q3). P-values were calculated using independent t-test, Wilcoxon rank-sum test. A two-sided p-value < 0.05 was considered statistically significant. Analysis performed in Stata 17 (StataCorp, College Station, TX).
